$comment: GET /v2/conferenceRecords/{conferenceRecordId}/participants -- verified against the Meet API v2 Discovery Document 2026-09-16. Who attended a FINISHED (or live) conference. A participant is ONE of three kinds -- signedinUser, anonymousUser, phoneUser -- never more than one at once, so all three are published and exactly one is non-null per row; that shape is pinned in the fixture rather than guessed at.
title: List participants

config.label: Conference record ID
config.description: The id from conference_record_list's data.conferenceRecords[].name (conferenceRecords/{id} -- give the id after the slash) or from space_get's data.activeConference.conferenceRecord.

outputShape.description: This page's participants. Each has name (participants/{id}), earliestStartTime, latestEndTime -- the SPAN across every time this person joined and left, not a single join/leave pair, since one person can rejoin -- and exactly one of signedinUser.displayName, anonymousUser.displayName, or phoneUser.displayName (a partially redacted phone number).
Present when there is another page.
